What is python-terminaltexteffects?

TerminalTextEffects (TTE) is a Python library and command-line tool that adds animated visual effects to text printed in the terminal — color gradients, particle-like motion paths, Matrix-style rain, and more. It ships 40+ built-in effects, usable either by piping text into the CLI application or by calling it as a library from your own scripts, with no third-party Python dependencies required.

Install python-terminaltexteffects on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add python-terminaltexteffects

Good to know

  • A terminal that supports Xterm 256 or RGB hex colors
